name: plant-uml-web
description: Plant UML Editor with py-sc-client, py-sc-kpm,sc-web,js-scs-editor

scripts.build:sc-web: npm install && cd external/sc-web && npm install && npm run build && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build:backend-linux: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all-linux: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && npm install && cd external/sc-web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all-win: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv\\Scripts\\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && npm install && cd external/sc-web && npm install && npm run build
